On its third-quarter 2023 call, PNC framed its 2024 expense plan around a goal to keep core expenses stable, which would exclude one-time charges. This objective was supported by two main initiatives: a staff reduction program expected to save approximately $325 million in 2024 and the continuation of its Continuous Improvement Program (CIP), for which PNC anticipated savings of similar magnitude to its 2023 goal.

U.S. Bancorp’s third-quarter 2023 call did not provide specific details on a 2024 expense plan or numerical targets. Instead, management highlighted that they were "prudently managing core expense" and identifying operational efficiencies across the business while achieving anticipated cost synergies from their acquisition of Union Bank.
